config.name: apiKey
config.description: Optional satoshidata.ai Agent API Bridge Pass key. Get one at https://satoshidata.ai/pay. Free tools work without a key.

tools.name: wallet_trust_safety
tools.description: Return satoshidata.ai's free Bitcoin wallet trust and safety teaser for a single address, including the examined marker when no clear category matched.

tools.name: address_risk
tools.description: Return factual address risk signals: entity label/category, source count, bounded behavioral flags, coarse risk_indicator, and an informational-only disclaimer. This is not AML/KYT/compliance advice.

tools.name: batch_trust_safety
tools.description: Look up labels and trust-safety signals for multiple Bitcoin addresses in one call. Returns the REST batch trust-safety payload and forwards X-WR-API-Key/Bearer auth when present.

params.name: addresses
params.description: Bitcoin addresses to look up, in result order.

tools.name: batch_summary
tools.description: Return satoshidata.ai wallet/entity summaries for multiple Bitcoin addresses in one call. Forwards X-WR-API-Key/Bearer auth when present.

params.name: addresses
params.description: Bitcoin addresses to summarize, in result order.

tools.name: batch_risk_signals
tools.description: Return factual label-derived risk indicators for multiple Bitcoin addresses in one call. Forwards X-WR-API-Key/Bearer auth when present.

params.name: addresses
params.description: Bitcoin addresses to score, in result order.

tools.name: risk_check
tools.description: Return a free evidence + confidence BTC screening bundle for one address, not a recommendation; you decide whether to transact.

tools.name: risk_check_batch
tools.description: Return free evidence + confidence BTC screening bundles for up to 100 addresses, not recommendations; you decide whether to transact.

params.name: addresses
params.description: Bitcoin addresses to screen, in result order.

tools.name: address_evidence_pack
tools.description: Return a free sectioned evidence report for one Bitcoin address. Packages labels, trust-safety, risk signals, optional risk_check, overview, recent transactions, and optional flow graph with component statuses. Evidence only: no score, verdict, clearance, or compliance recommendation.

params.name: depth
params.description: Flow-graph depth when include_graph=true.

params.name: address
params.description: Bitcoin wallet address to report on.

params.name: tx_limit
params.description: Recent transaction rows to include.

params.name: include_graph
params.description: Whether to include the bounded value-flow graph component.

tools.name: batch_intelligence
tools.description: Return satoshidata.ai address-intelligence cards for multiple Bitcoin addresses in one call. Forwards X-WR-API-Key/Bearer auth when present.

params.name: addresses
params.description: Bitcoin addresses to enrich, in result order.

tools.name: wallet_flow_graph
tools.description: Return a render-ready transaction-flow graph for a Bitcoin wallet address.

params.name: hops
params.description: Maximum graph hop depth.

params.name: view
params.description: Optional response view. Set `view=compact` for a smaller agent-oriented payload.

params.name: since
params.description: Only include transactions at or after this ISO timestamp.

params.name: address
params.description: Bitcoin wallet address to graph.

params.name: min_btc
params.description: Minimum BTC value for an edge candidate to appear. Default 0.1 BTC is a value-flow display filter; use min_btc=0 for ownership or attribution analysis.

params.name: direction
params.description: Transaction-flow direction to include: incoming, outgoing, or both.

params.name: node_limit
params.description: Maximum graph nodes to return.

params.name: include_labels
params.description: Include label/entity context for graph nodes when available.

tools.name: wallet_summary
tools.description: Return the premium satoshidata.ai chain intelligence summary for a single Bitcoin address.

tools.name: wallet_detail
tools.description: Return grouped satoshidata.ai label evidence and detail for a single Bitcoin address.

tools.name: wallet_contributors
tools.description: Return satoshidata.ai contributor depth and category distribution for a single Bitcoin address.

tools.name: address_intelligence
tools.description: Return the premium satoshidata.ai address-intelligence card for a single Bitcoin address, including current best label, live wallet activity, cohort hints, and scanner signals.

params.name: address
params.description: Bitcoin wallet address to enrich.

tools.name: bitcoin_price
tools.description: Return the current Bitcoin price snapshot and 24 hour change from satoshidata.ai.

tools.name: onchain_stats
tools.description: Return the current satoshidata.ai on-chain market and network snapshot.

tools.name: network_intelligence
tools.description: Return the combined Bitcoin network summary for agents: price, fees, mempool, blocks, and satoshidata.ai chain-intelligence context. Set include_charts=true only when chart arrays are needed.

tools.name: fees_recommended
tools.description: Return current recommended Bitcoin fee estimates from satoshidata.ai.

tools.name: mempool_stats
tools.description: Return the current Bitcoin mempool size, fee floor, and congestion summary.

tools.name: mempool_stress
tools.description: Return the current mempool-stress index. Set include_components=true or history_hours=1-168 for the Premium component/history payload; forwards Wallet+ Bearer or x402 payment headers when present.

tools.name: chain_awakenings
tools.description: Return dormant-coin awakening events over a bounded window. Supports filters for minimum dormancy age, minimum BTC value, window bounds, and result limit; forwards Wallet+ Bearer or x402 payment headers when present.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum rows to return.

params.name: since
params.description: Window start as block height, ISO date/time, or relative Nd value. Defaults to last 24h.

params.name: until
params.description: Window end as block height, ISO date/time, or now. Defaults to now.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Integer pagination cursor returned by the previous page.

params.name: format
params.description: Response format.

params.name: min_btc
params.description: Minimum BTC value of the spent dormant UTXO.

params.name: address_filter
params.description: Comma-separated Bitcoin address watchlist filter.

params.name: min_dormancy_days
params.description: Minimum untouched age of the spent UTXO.

tools.name: mempool_tx
tools.description: Inspect a single unconfirmed Bitcoin transaction currently in the mempool.

tools.name: block_detail
tools.description: Return Bitcoin block metadata, coinbase attribution, and a transaction sample for a height or block hash.

tools.name: entity_list
tools.description: Return named Bitcoin entity rollups, optionally filtered by category. coverage_status indicates whether each rollup is full, substantial, partial, or seed-only coverage; last_activity_at is label-DB activity, not last on-chain transaction time.

params.name: sort
params.description: Entity rollup sort order.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum entity rollups to return.

params.name: category
params.description: Optional entity category filter.

tools.name: entity_lookup
tools.description: Return one named Bitcoin entity rollup and a bounded member-address sample. coverage_status indicates whether the rollup is full, substantial, partial, or seed-only coverage; last_activity_at is label-DB activity, not last on-chain transaction time.

tools.name: entity_recent_activity
tools.description: Return a bounded recent on-chain activity sample for a small named Bitcoin entity.

tools.name: entity_categories
tools.description: Return available Bitcoin entity rollup categories, counts, and coverage_status distributions.

tools.name: whale_alerts
tools.description: Return recent large Bitcoin transfers with label-DB flow_type and flow_direction classification. range is one of 1d, 7d, or 30d; 24h is accepted by REST as a legacy alias for 1d. flow_direction is one of to_exchange, from_exchange, cross_exchange, or unknown.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum returned alerts. Capped at 1000.

params.name: range
params.description: Recent time window. `24h` is accepted as a legacy alias for `1d`.

params.name: offset
params.description: Zero-based offset into descending-time alerts after range and min_btc filtering.

params.name: min_btc
params.description: Minimum BTC amount for a transfer to appear in the feed.

params.name: flow_type
params.description: Optional comma-separated flow filter.

tools.name: pulse_whales
tools.description: Return recent large Bitcoin movements from satoshidata.ai's live on-chain Pulse feed.

tools.name: pulse_dormant
tools.description: Return recent dormant-coin reactivations from satoshidata.ai's live on-chain Pulse feed.

tools.name: pulse_consolidations
tools.description: Return recent consolidation candidates from satoshidata.ai's live on-chain Pulse feed.

tools.name: pulse_summary
tools.description: Return satoshidata.ai on-chain Pulse scanner health and 24-hour event totals.

tools.name: dormancy_flushes
tools.description: Return recent CMCS dormancy awakenings classified as exchange-bound sell pressure, housekeeping consolidation, HODLer rotation, or unknown.

tools.name: pool_list
tools.description: Return the free satoshidata.ai mining-pool roster with recent block-share windows.

tools.name: pool_detail
tools.description: Return free satoshidata.ai mining-pool detail for a named pool.

tools.name: mining_pool_info
tools.description: Return mining-pool attribution by block height/hash, known pool name, or candidate payout address. Block identifiers use /v1/blocks, pool names use /v1/pools/{pool_name}, and addresses use wallet trust-safety.

tools.name: tx_status
tools.description: Return a narrow Bitcoin transaction state check: unknown, mempool, conflicted, or confirmed.

tools.name: op_return_decode
tools.description: Decode OP_RETURN protocol markers and ordinals inscription envelopes for a Bitcoin transaction.

tools.name: tx_broadcast
tools.description: Broadcast a fully signed raw Bitcoin transaction hex through satoshidata.ai.

tools.name: tx_verify
tools.description: Verify that a Bitcoin transaction paid enough sats to the expected address with enough confirmations.

tools.name: timestamp_hash
tools.description: Submit a SHA-256 digest to satoshidata.ai's Bitcoin timestamping batch.

tools.name: timestamp_quote
tools.description: Return the current Bitcoin timestamping preflight quote, including the fixed service fee and estimated anchor-fee share.

tools.name: verify_timestamp
tools.description: Verify a detached OpenTimestamps proof against the Bitcoin blockchain.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Submit machine-readable label corrections, missing-label suggestions, data-quality reports, or general feedback.
